messages:
Nora: Heads-up — onboarding sampleapp failing on rerank + embed interop. Multiple SDKs disagree on vector length and the rerank response shape changed unexpectedly.
Vik: Can you paste the failing request/response?
Nora: Sanitized outbound: HTTP header `X-Vec-Format: base64-f32le` and payload body: `{"embedding":{"dim":1024,"values_b64":"...base64..."}}`. The rust client encoded floats little-endian and appended a \u0000 terminator due to the base64 helper. Server decodes and sees 1025 floats. Error: `400 embedding length mismatch: declared 1024 vs decoded 1025`.
Simone: Wait, rust client added a terminator? I thought our rust helper used Vec<f32> -> bytes. Where did the trailing null come from?
Jae: I dug in — in the rust-sampleapp we call `bytes.extend(&[0u8])` accidentally in the debug path when feature "legacy-compat" is enabled. The C# sample (which uses JSON floats) trimmed trailing zeros differently and reported len=1024. So we have cross-SDK inconsistency.
Nora: Also, even after fixing the trailing null, QA hit a second problem: the rerank endpoint started returning `rankings: [{"id":"doc1","score":0.8}, ...]` in the new rollouts, while python-sdk still expects `scores: [0.8, 0.5, ...]` and crashes on parsing. So two separate DX issues surfaced simultaneously and made debugging noisy.
Vik: Ugh. Were there auth retries during the runs? Any chance retries mutated buffers?
Nora: There was a 401 -> refresh -> retry in the trace but the two POST bodies were byte-identical after base64 encoding. So token refresh didn't mutate payload here. The main cause was inconsistent encoding / debug trailing byte in rust, and the response shape change from the rolling backend.
Simone: For embeddings, server should canonicalize by deriving length = decoded_float_count and ignore client-declared `dim`. If mismatch, return explicit error: `declared dim X != decoded count Y`. Also log which SDK sent it (user-agent) to help triage.
Jae: For rerank response shape, we need backward-compatible API: keep returning `scores` array for now and add `rankings` objects as an optional richer field. SDKs should be updated to accept either and warn when deprecated shape used.
Vik: Action items: 1) hotfix rust sampleapp to remove trailing null and add unit test for base64 packing. 2) server change to derive canonical_dim from decoded payload and return clearer error message. 3) server to add a compatibility layer: if `rankings` present, populate `scores` for older SDKs. 4) sdk teams to accept both response shapes for next release.
Nora: I've opened a small repro in a gist and added a failing test in sampleapp-rust.
sdk-bot: Created INF-4520: "embed/rerank interop: trailing-bytes in base64-f32le + response shape change" and linked rust/csharp/python SDK teams.
ci-bot: CI: sampleapp-rust test failing 1/1 on master — reproduces trailing null behaviour.
Simone: I'll patch the server middleware today to compute dim from decoded bytes and to backfill `scores` when `rankings` present, plus return human-friendly errors. Will canary it.
Vik: SDK owners: please add tolerant parsing for rerank responses: prefer `scores` array if present, else fallback to `rankings[*].score`. Add a warning log on the fallback.
Jae: I'll push the rust-sampleapp PR shortly and add a fuzz test for base64 helpers. Also adding a linter to prevent accidental push of debug-only byte appends.
Nora: Thanks. For onboarding DX let's document canonical encoding: base64 of IEEE754 little-endian float32 array, no terminator, server derives dim from decoded count. Put a short note in the SDK CONTRIBUTING and sampleapp README.
Simone: Deploy-bot — canary the middleware change with metrics to surface any client breaks.
sdk-bot: INF-4520 updated with links to PRs and canary pipeline #7145.
Nora: I'll follow-up with PR links here when available. If anyone wants to pair on the repro, ping me. :thumbsup:
